title: Neural-network interpretation identifies a metabolic panel associated with Moyamoya disease
summary: A neural network learned serum patterns distinguishing Moyamoya disease from healthy controls. Model interpretation helped select six metabolic signals; their later three-center evaluation reported AUC 0.867, rather than the higher full-fingerprint result.
organization: Fudan University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University

evidence.tested: Discovery data comprised 144 patients and 144 controls; repeated spectra were averaged per sample. The six-signal panel was evaluated in 86 later samples, including 49 cases.
evidence.unknown: Selected case-control evaluation; preprocessing and feature-selection nesting are incompletely established. Metabolite assignments are tentative. No population screening, stroke prevention or mechanistic claim.
evidence.ai_role: The network learns diagnostic patterns; integrated gradients guides signal selection alongside statistical comparisons.

source_review.scope: Primary front identity/date and relevant clinical/model Methods and classification Results; operational sample procedures excluded.
